title: Joseph Haydn's birth chart
metaDescription: Joseph Haydn's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 11.0° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 11.0° Aries, in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 11.0° into Aries — the second decan, which the old scheme hands to the Sun. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 1.1° Aries, Venus at 15.4° Taurus, Mars at 5.0° Sagittarius. Mercury in a fire sign reads as thought that arrives already in motion; Venus in an earth sign reads as attraction that grows by reliability; Mars in a fire sign reads as effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Mars to Jupiter, a sextile with 0.8° of slack. A sixth of the circle is close enough for cooperation and far enough that it stays optional. Behind it, the Sun trine Uranus at 0.8°, and Neptune trine Pluto at 1.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags three placements in this chart. The Sun in Aries at 11.0° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Taurus at 15.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Aries at 7.3° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 5 fire, 4 air, 1 earth by element and 5 cardinal, 4 mutable, 1 fixed by mode. Fire leads with ignition: the first move made early, and certainty arriving ahead of the evidence. No settled placement falls in water — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Jupiter, Uranus and Pluto were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Gemini for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.2° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 19.5°.
